claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger / WeaponFilter support for ranged_or_thrown weapon attack and free-hand gating
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing triggered-reaction family fits, but the current trigger grammar cannot represent a hit from either a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon, and it cannot require that the reactor has a free hand before the reaction is available.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon ... if you have a free hand.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: catch_projectile_or_weapon
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a second deterministic rider beyond damage reduction: if the prevented damage is reduced to 0, the defender can catch the ammunition or weapon. No current effect atom represents conditional item capture after damage prevention.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon if it is small enough for you to hold in that hand.
